digest.component_or_area: Jira family sub-seam (Cloud and Data Center adapter unification)
propositions: PR #120's forked second Jira adapter reaches into private symbols and duplicates mapping logic across adapters/jira/ and adapters/jira_datacenter/, creating an unsanctioned dependency inversion with no structural boundary enforcement.

Three independent copies of the local-to-Jira status and priority maps exist in adapters/jira/jira_fields.py, adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py, and rebar_reconciler/config.py, and two copies have already drifted on the 'deleted' key, causing silent misclassification.

Jira Data Center and Cloud diverge on three axes—REST v2 with wiki/plain-text bodies vs v3 ADF, PAT bearer auth vs ACLI subprocess, name-based user identity vs accountId—which must be captured as explicit shared contracts (RichTextCodec and UserIdentityModel) rather than forked implementations.

Location-pinned modules adf.py, outbound_fields.py, and comment_limits.py are loaded by file path and cannot relocate without breaking the dynamic loader, yet they must share their logic across both adapters without creating circular dependencies.

The DC backend lacks enforcement that it rejects non-HTTPS base_url unless explicitly overridden, never disables certificate verification, requires a dedicated low-privilege PAT from environment variables only, and logs warnings when insecure modes are enabled.
